facts.fact: DatacenterDynamics (3 May 2023) reports GPX Global Systems opened its first Cairo data center in 2007 and currently operates two facilities in Cairo; the document does not say outright that it sells space to outside customers.

DatacenterDynamics (3 May 2023) reports GPX Global Systems launched its Cairo 2 data center in 2015, and that it currently operates there (3,000 sqm, 5MW); GPX is a data center operator and the document does not say outright that it sells space to outside customers.

note: Expansion of Cairo 2 (EGP 2.7bn, +12MW) is announced and not a fact; no tier or cloud region stated.
